    Hello!

    News


    • 13-17/07/26: I will be giving two talks, on cell size control and quantitative evolution, at the 14th European Conference on Mathematical & Theoretical Biology in Graz, Austria!


    • 01/05/26: I'm starting a new postdoc with Pieter Rein ten Wolde in AMOLF!


    • 08/01/26: Our preprint on cell size control with Philipp Thomas is now online!

    I am a theoretical physicist working on complex systems inspired by biology, with tools from stochastic processes, statistical physics and thermodynamics.

    I am currently a postdoc in AMOLF in Amsterdam, in the group of Pieter Rein ten Wolde. Before that, I was an independent postdoc at the Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems in Dresden, Germany. I obtained my PhD with David Lacoste at the Gulliver laboratory in Paris. Besides, I am also invested in teaching, and fond of history and philosophy of sciences!
